# Reader access plan

## Constraints

Pinned main is fe09574da48ecaff1b41c78ee6c1fa1dbe9bc66b. The repository requires .github/specs, explicit branch/path checks and preservation of machine-local .specify/feature.json. Product policy records emailed single-use codes, online reading of the shorter edition, maximum thirty-day returning access, separate optional newsletter, purpose-limited records and no launch offline manuscript access. Architecture is unresolved.

## Boundaries

005 owns reader-access requirements and reconciliation. 004 remains launch package and historical source. The six contracts remain in 004 until a separate exact move proposal. Mixed 004 coordination files do not move.

Candidate source/destination pairs, not executed: each of the six 004/contracts/prompt-3 files to corresponding 005/contracts paths. A later move requires complete content or reconstructable move-plus-diff, relative-link repairs, identity mappings and backlink review.

## Sequence

1. Reconcile current main, 004 sources, Linear v1.13.0 and destination.
2. Resolve provider, manuscript, expiry, recovery, consent, privacy and concurrency evidence.
3. Preview one bounded implementation stage.
4. Obtain stage approval; re-read sources and validate canonical containment.
5. Implement only the approved stage; read back and verify.
6. Stop at the manual GitHub checkpoint.

Preserve all source documents, governance, application code, deployment configuration, Linear records, catalogues, task lists, 004 files and reviewer markers. No tests, forms, provider calls or deployment checks were run.
